subject: Hiring criteria workshop — scope, leveling, interview focus
messages:
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Cc: sasha@hirebase.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Prep: 1hr workshop to align on FE senior role — draft agenda + materials

Hi team,

Thanks for making time. Per our hiring cadence for the Senior Frontend Engineer (Serving) role, I'd like to run a short workshop to align the hiring managers and our bar-raiser on scope and leveling expectations. Goal is to tighten the rubric before we send out the panel invites this week.

Draft agenda (30–40 min discussion + 20 min action items):
- Quick role scope review (5 min): key outcomes we expect in 6–12 months
- Leveling signals (10 min): what separates Senior vs Staff for this stream
- Interview focus areas & question mapping (10 min): ownership, systems thinking, cross-team collaboration, production inference constraints
- Bar-raiser calibration (10 min): failure modes, candidate red flags, calibration examples
- Next steps / assignments (15 min)

Attachments: senior_fe_scope_v1.pdf (role brief), bar_raiser_guidelines.docx (current bar-raiser checklist). Also adding the Drive link here: https://drive.google.com/drive/fakeid/FE-role-brief

Can we meet Tuesday 10–11 PT? If that doesn't work, propose Wed 2–3 PT.

Quick ask: please skim the scope doc and flag any items you believe are "stretch" for Senior vs those that should be Staff. No lengthy reviews — just 2–3 bullets in reply.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Talent Partner, Redwood Inference

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com, sasha@hirebase.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Prep: 1hr workshop to align on FE senior role — draft agenda + materials

Marissa — thanks, this looks good. Tuesday 10–11 PT works for me. A couple quick notes after a skim:

- "Production inference constraints" should call out latency budgets and cache invalidation ownership explicitly — that tends to be a common mismatch in candidate expectations.
- For Leveling signals: add "history of shipping feature-facing APIs with backwards compat guarantees" as a Staff signal; Senior can own API surface design within a team but not cross-team contract governance.

I'll add two short examples from recent interviews (one clear pass, one that missed on systems thinking) to illustrate.

One small ask: can Lauren act as the bar-raiser for this loop? Her recent serving interview calibration was spot on.

See you Tuesday,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Lead, Front-end Platform
Redwood Inference

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Prep: 1hr workshop to align on FE senior role — draft agenda + materials

Thanks for the invite — happy to be the bar-raiser for this hiring loop.

A couple of quick calibration notes from my side before the workshop:
- Focus area prioritization: put ownership & reliability > breadth of JavaScript frameworks. We want someone who enforces correct runtime behavior in inference paths more than someone who knows the latest UI micro-framework.
- Leveling examples I'd like to walk through:
  * Senior: designed a subsystem (client-side caching + op queuing) that reduced 95th percentile latency by >20% within a single product team.
  * Staff: led cross-team initiative to standardize client runtime contracts and de-risked a migration (measurable adoption across 3 teams).
- Question mapping: I can bring a small written scenario that tests prioritization of correctness vs feature shipping (30–40s case we can use live).

I'll be brief in the workshop — main objective is to produce a tight rubric and a one-page interviewer guide.

Lauren Bishop
Principal Engineer (Bar-raiser)

From: dev_patel@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: sasha@hirebase.com, cody@acme.com, recruiting-ops@acme.com
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Prep: 1hr workshop to align on FE senior role — draft agenda + materials

Forwarding for scheduling confirmation and to loop candidate logistics.

Jonas / Marissa / Lauren — Tuesday 10–11 PT confirmed on my calendar (invite sent). Action items before the workshop:
- Marissa: please distribute the one-page rubric draft (can be a Google Doc) by EOD Monday so we can iterate quickly.
- Jonas: please upload the two interview examples you mentioned to the Drive link.
- Lauren: bring the live scenario; we'll timebox to 5–7 min during the session.

Sasha / Acme recruiting — we expect to finalize panel invites after this session. Cody, please keep Tue morning free in case we need to adjust the loop dates; we'll follow up with specific panel times.

Attachments referenced above are on the Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fakeid/FE-role-brief and also attached to this thread: senior_fe_scope_v1.pdf, bar_raiser_guidelines.docx

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Engineering Manager, Front-end Platform
Redwood Inference
